meta.title: CardioScope — Interactive 3D cardiac anatomy simulator
meta.titleZh: CardioScope — 完整心脏三维交互模拟器
meta.status: Educational simulation / not patient anatomy / not clinically validated
meta.statusZh: 教育模拟 / 非患者解剖 / 未经临床验证

meshes.name: Left ventricle
meshes.descriptionEn: The left ventricle pumps oxygenated blood into the aorta. Its wall is thick and generates high pressure.
meshes.descriptionZh: 左心室负责向主动脉泵出含氧血液，壁厚、压力高。

meshes.name: Right ventricle
meshes.descriptionEn: The right ventricle pumps venous blood into the pulmonary artery. It wraps around the left ventricle in a crescent; the shape here is a teaching schematic.
meshes.descriptionZh: 右心室把静脉血泵入肺动脉，形态呈环抱左心室的半月形；此处为教学示意。

meshes.name: Left atrium
meshes.descriptionEn: The left atrium receives oxygenated blood from the pulmonary veins and passes it to the left ventricle through the mitral valve.
meshes.descriptionZh: 左心房接受来自肺静脉的富氧血，并经二尖瓣送入左心室。

meshes.name: Right atrium
meshes.descriptionEn: The right atrium receives venous blood from the superior and inferior venae cavae and passes it to the right ventricle through the tricuspid valve.
meshes.descriptionZh: 右心房接受上、下腔静脉回流的静脉血，经三尖瓣送入右心室。

meshes.name: Aorta
meshes.descriptionEn: The aorta is the trunk of the systemic circulation. It arises from the left ventricle and delivers oxygenated blood to the body.
meshes.descriptionZh: 体循环主干：起于左心室，向全身输送富氧血。

meshes.name: Pulmonary trunk
meshes.descriptionEn: The pulmonary trunk connects the right ventricle to the left and right pulmonary arteries and carries venous blood into the pulmonary circulation.
meshes.descriptionZh: 肺动脉干连接右心室与左右肺动脉，将静脉血送向肺循环。

meshes.name: Left pulmonary artery
meshes.descriptionEn: The left pulmonary artery supplies the left lung and is part of the pulmonary circulation.
meshes.descriptionZh: 左肺动脉向左肺供血，属于肺循环。

meshes.name: Right pulmonary artery
meshes.descriptionEn: The right pulmonary artery supplies the right lung and is part of the pulmonary circulation.
meshes.descriptionZh: 右肺动脉向右肺供血，属于肺循环。

meshes.name: Superior vena cava
meshes.descriptionEn: The superior vena cava collects venous blood from the head, neck, upper limbs, and part of the thorax and returns it to the right atrium.
meshes.descriptionZh: 收集头颈、上肢和胸部部分静脉血，回流右心房。

meshes.name: Inferior vena cava
meshes.descriptionEn: The inferior vena cava collects venous blood from the lower body and returns it to the right atrium.
meshes.descriptionZh: 收集下半身静脉血，回流右心房。

meshes.name: Pulmonary vein
meshes.descriptionEn: Pulmonary veins return oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium. The course shown is a teaching schematic.
meshes.descriptionZh: 肺静脉将肺内氧合血输送回左心房；路径为教学抽象示意。

meshes.name: Pulmonary vein
meshes.descriptionEn: Pulmonary veins return oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium. The course shown is a teaching schematic.
meshes.descriptionZh: 肺静脉将肺内氧合血输送回左心房；路径为教学抽象示意。

meshes.name: Pulmonary vein
meshes.descriptionEn: Pulmonary veins return oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium. The course shown is a teaching schematic.
meshes.descriptionZh: 肺静脉将肺内氧合血输送回左心房；路径为教学抽象示意。

meshes.name: Pulmonary vein
meshes.descriptionEn: Pulmonary veins return oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium. The course shown is a teaching schematic.
meshes.descriptionZh: 肺静脉将肺内氧合血输送回左心房；路径为教学抽象示意。

meshes.name: Mitral valve
meshes.descriptionEn: The mitral valve is the left atrioventricular valve. It limits regurgitation into the left atrium during ventricular systole.
meshes.descriptionZh: 左房室瓣：限制心室收缩时血液向左心房反流。

meshes.name: Tricuspid valve
meshes.descriptionEn: The tricuspid valve is the right atrioventricular valve. It limits regurgitation into the right atrium during right-ventricular systole.
meshes.descriptionZh: 右房室瓣：限制右心室收缩时血液向右心房反流。

meshes.name: Aortic valve
meshes.descriptionEn: The aortic valve is the semilunar valve at the aortic outlet. It prevents aortic blood from flowing back into the left ventricle in diastole.
meshes.descriptionZh: 主动脉出口半月瓣：阻止舒张期主动脉血液反流入左心室。

meshes.name: Pulmonary valve
meshes.descriptionEn: The pulmonary valve is the semilunar valve at the pulmonary outlet. It prevents pulmonary arterial blood from flowing back into the right ventricle.
meshes.descriptionZh: 肺动脉出口半月瓣：阻止肺动脉血液反流入右心室。

meshes.name: Left main
meshes.descriptionEn: The left main usually arises from the left coronary sinus and divides into the anterior descending and circumflex arteries.
meshes.descriptionZh: 左主干通常起源于左冠窦，分为前降支和回旋支。

meshes.name: LAD
meshes.descriptionEn: The left anterior descending artery courses in the anterior interventricular groove and supplies important territory of the anterior wall and septum.
meshes.descriptionZh: 左前降支沿前室间沟走行，供应心室前壁及室间隔重要区域。

meshes.name: LCx
meshes.descriptionEn: The left circumflex artery courses in the left atrioventricular groove and gives off obtuse marginal branches.
meshes.descriptionZh: 左回旋支沿左侧房室沟走行，发出钝缘支等分支。

meshes.name: Diagonal 1
meshes.descriptionEn: The first diagonal branch arises from the anterior descending artery and mainly supplies the anterolateral left-ventricular wall.
meshes.descriptionZh: 第一对角支由前降支发出，主要供应左心室前外侧壁。

meshes.name: Diagonal 2
meshes.descriptionEn: Schematic of the second diagonal branch.
meshes.descriptionZh: 第二对角支示意。

meshes.name: Obtuse marginal
meshes.descriptionEn: Obtuse marginal branches supply the lateral left-ventricular wall and are major branches of the circumflex artery.
meshes.descriptionZh: 钝缘支供应左心室外侧壁，是回旋支的主要分支之一。

meshes.name: Obtuse marginal 2
meshes.descriptionEn: Schematic of the second obtuse marginal branch.
meshes.descriptionZh: 第二钝缘支示意。

meshes.name: RCA
meshes.descriptionEn: The right coronary artery usually arises from the right coronary sinus and courses in the right atrioventricular groove.
meshes.descriptionZh: 右冠脉通常起源于右冠窦，沿右侧房室沟走行。

meshes.name: Acute marginal
meshes.descriptionEn: The acute marginal branch usually arises from the right coronary artery and supplies the right-ventricular free wall.
meshes.descriptionZh: 锐缘支通常由右冠脉发出，供应右心室游离壁。

meshes.name: Posterior descending
meshes.descriptionEn: The origin of the posterior descending artery depends on coronary dominance. In a right-dominant circulation it usually arises from the right coronary artery.
meshes.descriptionZh: 后降支来源取决于冠脉优势型。右优势时通常源自右冠脉。

meshes.name: Posterolateral
meshes.descriptionEn: Schematic course of a posterolateral branch.
meshes.descriptionZh: 后外侧分支走行示意。
